name: status-monitor
description: Serverless uptime monitor and pager on Cloudflare Workers: tiered escalation, SMS-reply acknowledgement, signed deep health checks and a status page.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p status-page/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.dry-run:status-page: npm run build:status-page && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config status-page/wrangler.jsonc --outdir "$PWD/dist/status-page"
